summary: Original game full Clear -> successful pre-Draw UpdateSurface/StretchRect into owned canonical D3D9 backbuffer -> current CPU-staged full color snapshot -> real native SM3/FVF game Draw and guarded same-Present. Subsequent fills replay after snapshot in source order; all unsupported writes remain D3D9 fallback. Runtime/HMD untested.

feature_contract.goal: Preserve authentic pre-Draw game backbuffer UpdateSurface/StretchRect color for menu -> vehicle -> race native SM3/FVF Draw/DrawIndexed while retaining original D3D9 input/FFB/Present fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Capture original successful canonical backbuffer copy after an authored Clear and before the first native game Draw, with authentic dimensions and color.
Seed actual first real game SM3 and fixed-function native frame with copied D3D9 pixels and preserve subsequent ordered game fills.
Reject wrong owner, stale copies, unsupported format/size, failed readback and invalid epochs without modifying D3D9 Draw, Present or input.
All mandatory DX11 Fast, Backend Conversion, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD Inspector checks succeed on the same validation-bearing SHA.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Game-authored full backbuffer clear, successful preDraw UpdateSurface/StretchRect, ordered partial fill, real native SM3/FVF Draw and Present.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Foreign device/RT, open CPU write, invalid size, unsupported D3D9 readback, stale prior frame and unproven source Draw reject native replay.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Real D3D9 copy hook and CPU staging + native SM3 and FVF first-Draw RTV UpdateSubresource + original game Present fallback.

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: NativeDrawPathActive=false/default opt-in; DX11 full game frame only with exact D3D9 canonical owner, otherwise unchanged original D3D9 Draw/Present/input/FFB; DXVK frozen.
